name: TableOfContents
summary: An article's sections as in-page links in a glass panel, named by its visible title.

guidance.useFor: Long articles and documentation with four or more sections: beside the prose on wide screens, above it on narrow ones.
insteadUse: Moving between pages: Site header or Pagination
Panels of content shown one at a time: Tabs
content: Mark the section being read with aria-current="true"

rungReason: <nav> with an ordered list of in-page links; the browser moves focus and scroll on activation.

attributes.aria-current: true, on the section being read

rules: The headings it links to get scroll-margin-block-start (in .lue-prose), so a sticky header doesn't cover them
The current section is said in words (aria-current) and shown by more than colour
Highlighting the section from scroll position is a later enhancement (ADR-0011)
contrast: An opaque surface (--lue-color-bg-surface) under increased contrast, reduced transparency or without backdrop-filter
forcedColors: Canvas with a CanvasText border; the current link in Highlight, underlined
